stage: Develop; clean installation not yet proven

independenceGate.passRule: Every required ID passes with runner identity and evidence digests for the same artifact tuple; missing, blocked or stale evidence fails closed
independenceGate.implementation: Pending: this static inventory supports part of I03, not the complete gate

native.purpose: Desktop process launch and shell helpers
Absolute host actions and state files
User units, login/sleep and notification bus
Wayland session and Hyprland IPC; selected build must support the product's Lua dispatches
Retained idle/sleep behavior; enablement follows the selected policy
Retained locker with host-owned PAM and packaged configuration
Qt/Wayland shell and Quickshell QML modules
Graphical session environment and application launch
Power profile controls; unavailable service must degrade explicitly

facilities.proof: Fresh graphical login imports WAYLAND_DISPLAY and Hyprland IPC identity into the user manager and starts graphical-session.target
Native Qt/Wayland/DRM stack loads all eight plugins; matching Quickshell modules and driver bridge
Audio panel, mute/volume/media keys and desktop recording audio
NetworkManager D-Bus access, Wi-Fi panel and QR workflow
Enabled Bluetooth service and panel behavior on capable hardware
Shell authorization agent and locker authenticate through host-owned policy/PAM
File selection, screen sharing and application access in the new session
Selected application and portal credentials survive login and remain outside public defaults
Preserved capture workflows from packaged helper chains; exact independent tools/providers selected with their implementations
Independently installed terminal, editor and browser desktop entries resolve without workstation overrides
Host-specific IDs, boot/initramfs update, fallback/recovery and sleep/resume after every changed root integration

pending.proof: Implement and run all nine tuple-bound checks from the product plan; static scan success cannot substitute for runtime, migration, network or recovery evidence
All retained actions, conditions and provider-generated calls resolve from declared packages, including transitive helpers
Owned default theme/background, icon and text fonts render today's desktop without inherited assets or pre-existing XDG state
Packaged fresh-host compositor/session/keybinding defaults; consumer contributes only selections and machine values
Renamed native registrations and helpers with actual extension permissions and copy/download tests
Independent editor integration with preserved user data
Inspected system settings/services/hooks classified and required behavior delivered by pinned native packages
Exact third-party sources, recipes, signatures and channels recorded; no inherited repository/server required
Actual clean Arch installation, login/workflows, blocked inherited domains, update and rollback with exact artifact identities

limits: Native package names are the host contract, not proof of independent availability or exact versions. Binary presence and lexical scans cannot establish complete runtime closure, bus/service availability, visual behavior or clean-host acceptance. Pending requirements always block candidate readiness.
